account.timeZoneHint: Only your personal quiet hours use it. Due dates and reminder times stay in each household's time zone.
totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.intro: Require a code from an authenticator app when you sign in.
totp.setupIntro: Add this account to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
totp.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.scan: Scan with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password …), or enter the key below.
totp.disableWarn: Your account will be protected by your password alone.
totp.codesIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your authenticator. They won't be shown again.
sessions.title: Devices
audit.title: Recent account activity
audit.intro: Sign-ins and security changes on your account.
audit.mail_gave_up: An email could not be delivered
push.title: This device
push.privacy: Browser notifications are delivered through your browser vendor's push service (Google, Apple or Mozilla). The message is end-to-end encrypted, but the vendor can see that a notification was sent to your device and when.
push.enable: Turn on reminders on this device
push.unsupported: This browser can't show reminders. Use email or a messaging app below instead.
push.insecure: Reminders on this device need a secure (HTTPS) connection to Gunkly. Use email or a messaging app below instead.
export.accountIntro: Download a copy of your account data as a JSON file: profile, preferences, household memberships, the chores you completed, the names of your notification channels (never their addresses), your devices and your sign-in history.
emailSection.title: Email address
emailSection.none: No email address on this account.
emailSection.unverifiedNote: Confirm it with the link we emailed to reset your password by email or use email codes.
emailSection.sent: Check your inbox: we sent a confirmation link to the new address. It only changes once you open it.
emailSection.hint: We email a link to the new address and tell the old one. Nothing changes until the link is opened.
emailcodes.title: Email codes
emailcodes.intro: Get a 6-digit code by email each time you sign in, instead of using an authenticator app.
emailcodes.mailbox: Anyone who can open your email can use these codes and reset your password. An authenticator app is stronger.
emailcodes.mandatory: Two-factor authentication is required on this server. Switch to an authenticator app to stop using email codes.
totp.replacesEmail: Setting this up replaces email codes.
totp.mandatory: Two-factor authentication is required on this server, so it can't be turned off.
push.disable: Turn off reminders on this device
delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Deleting your account removes your profile, sign-ins, notification channels and personal data for good. Chores you completed stay in your households as "Deleted user".
delete.households: These households have no other member who can use them and will be deleted with their chores:
tokens.title: Integrations
tokens.intro: Let other apps use Gunkly on your behalf with an access token, for example Home Assistant or an AI assistant that speaks MCP. Each token is limited to the households and permissions you choose, and can be revoked at any time.
tokens.needHouseholdFirst: Create or join a household first.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameHint: What it is for, for example Home Assistant.
tokens.permissionsHint: A token can never change members, settings, notification channels or your account, and never delete a household. It also never does more than your own role in a household allows.
tokens.scopeComplete: Mark chores done, snooze, skip and pause them
tokens.scopeWrite: Add, change and delete chores and their reminders
tokens.once: Copy this token now and keep it secret. It won't be shown again, and anyone who has it can use it within the permissions you chose.
tokens.revokeWarn: Anything using this token stops working at once. This can't be undone.
audit.token_complete: Chore completed with an access token
mcp.title: Connect an AI assistant
mcp.intro: Let an AI assistant such as Claude look after your chores for you. You can ask things like "What is overdue?" or say "I watered the plants".
mcp.point1: It can only use the households and actions you allow.
mcp.point2: It can never change members, settings or your account.
mcp.point3: You can cut off its access at any time under "Revoke" below.
mcp.disabled: AI assistant access is switched off on this server. Ask the server's administrator if you would like it turned on.
mcp.alwaysRead: It can always see your chores and what is due.
mcp.mayComplete: Mark chores as done, snooze or skip
mcp.readyTitle: Your assistant is ready to connect
mcp.once: This access key is shown only once and works like a password. Anyone who has it can use it, so don't share it. You can revoke it below at any time.

push.statusOn: On: this device shows a notification when a chore is due.
push.statusOff: Off: this device does not show reminders yet.
push.iosSteps: On iPhone or iPad, reminders work once Gunkly is on your Home Screen: open Gunkly in Safari, tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then open Gunkly from the Home Screen and come back here.
emailReminders.title: Email me reminders
emailReminders.label: Email me reminders
emailReminders.hint: Reminders go to {email}, at the same times as everything else. Each email has a link to mark the chore as done.
emailReminders.needVerified: To get reminders by email, add your email address and confirm it first.
emailReminders.changed: Email reminders turn off if you change your email address; turn them on again afterwards.
quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.label: Quiet hours for my reminders
quietHours.hint: Reminders to this device, your email and your messaging apps wait until quiet hours end (one per chore). Household channels, such as a family group, are not affected, and the household's own quiet hours still apply.
quietHours.zoneOwn: Read in your time zone, {zone}. You can change it under Profile.
quietHours.zoneHousehold: Read in each household's time zone. Set your own time zone under Profile if your households are in different zones.
channels.advancedHint: Telegram, Discord, Slack, ntfy and more. Only needed if you prefer a messaging app.
audit.oauth_token_reuse: App disconnected after a reused credential
apps.title: Connected apps
apps.intro: Apps you signed in to Gunkly with. Disconnect one to cut off its access at once.
apps.disconnectWarn: It stops working at once. You can connect it again later.
mcp.connExpect: You will sign in to Gunkly and choose what it may use. No access key is needed; leave any client ID or secret empty.
mcp.connPublic: Gunkly must be reachable at a public HTTPS address.
mcp.connOff: Sign-in for apps such as ChatGPT is off on this server. Ask its administrator to turn it on (Administration, Instance settings).
mcp.connSteps: In {app}, open Settings, then Connectors, add a custom connector and paste this address.
audit.webhook_auto_disable: Webhook switched off after repeated failures
account.group.integrationsHint: Access tokens, AI assistants, connected apps
passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password, and also works as a second factor after one. Your device keeps the key; Gunkly only stores the public half.
passkeys.needsHttps: Passkeys need Gunkly to be reached at an https address (or localhost). Ask the administrator to set GUNKLY_BASE_URL to it.
passkeys.secondFactorNote: With a passkey on your account, signing in with a password also asks for a passkey (or a recovery code).
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: So you can tell it apart, for example “Laptop” or “Phone”.
passkeys.removeWarn: “{name}” will no longer sign you in or count as a second factor. Your other devices are signed out.
passkeys.codesIntro: Passkey added. Save these recovery codes somewhere safe: each works once if you lose your passkey.
sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.intro: Sign in with {name} instead of a password. Your provider checks it is you, including any second factor it asks for; Gunkly then does not ask for another one.
sso.introGeneric: Sign in through your organisation's identity provider instead of a password. Your provider checks it is you, including any second factor it asks for; Gunkly then does not ask for another one.
sso.unlinkWarn: You will no longer be able to sign in this way. Your other devices are signed out.
sso.needPassword: This account has no password. Set one (under Password) or add a passkey before unlinking.
